claims.claim: Environment Canada says a storm surge could hit low-lying exposed coastal areas of Metro Vancouver, southeast Vancouver Island and the southern Gulf Islands, peaking from 10 a.m. to noon.
claims.source_title: Rains ease but storm surge heads for southwest B.C., posing new flood risk
claims.supporting_quote: It says elevated water levels surpassing tidal predictions will be driven by high winds and “enhanced wave activity,” and are expected to peak from 10 a.m. to noon.

claims.claim: More than 300 millimetres of rain has fallen on parts of southwest B.C.
claims.source_title: Rains ease but storm surge heads for southwest B.C., posing new flood risk
claims.supporting_quote: The drenching has brought more than 300 millimetres of rain to parts of southwest B.C.

claims.claim: Pemberton remains under an evacuation alert with parts under an evacuation order, and evacuation orders are in place for the Lil'wat First Nation and Zeballos.
claims.episode_span: evacuation orders remain for parts of Pemberton, the Lil'wat First Nation and Zeballos
claims.source_title: Rains ease but storm surge heads for southwest B.C., posing new flood risk
claims.supporting_quote: The village of Pemberton, about 150 kilometres north of Vancouver, is still under an evacuation alert, with parts of the community under evacuation order.

claims.claim: Federal data put B.C. flu activity in the high category, with 17.8 to 27.4 per cent of tests positive, and only Nunavut ranked higher.
claims.episode_span: 17.8 to 27.4 per cent of tests positive
claims.source_title: B.C. among Canada's flu hot spots as outbreaks hit long-term care homes
claims.supporting_quote: The latest federal data put B.C.’s flu activity in the “high” category, with 17.8 to 27.4 per cent of flu tests coming back positive at public health laboratories. Only Nunavut ranked higher.

claims.claim: Fraser Health lists 12 active influenza outbreaks at long-term care homes declared between October 23 and November 10, and Vancouver Coastal Health lists five.
claims.episode_span: Fraser Health lists 12 active influenza outbreaks
claims.source_title: B.C. among Canada's flu hot spots as outbreaks hit long-term care homes
claims.supporting_quote: Fraser Health’s latest online bulletin lists 12 active influenza outbreaks at long-term care homes, declared between Oct. 23 and Nov. 10.

claims.claim: A man was shot and killed Thursday shortly after 7:15 a.m. at a residence in the 10600-block of 132 Street in Surrey, and IHIT is investigating.
claims.episode_span: shot and killed Thursday shortly after 7:15 a.m.
claims.supporting_quote: THE Integrated Homicide Investigation Team (IHIT) has been called in by Surrey Police Service after a man was shot and killed on Thursday shortly after 7:15 a.m. at a residence in the 10600-block of 132 Street.

claims.claim: Surrey lists Benjie Lee as acting city solicitor and Jason Cairney as acting general manager of public safety, and the city declined to comment on personnel matters.
claims.episode_span: Benjie Lee is listed as acting city solicitor
claims.source_title: There appear to have been senior staff changes at Surrey City Hall. The city won't talk about them
claims.supporting_quote: Benjie Lee is listed as the acting city solicitor, a position held by Philip Huynh before the election.

claims.claim: The unfinished Centra tower at 13862 101 Avenue is offered for $30 million in a court-ordered sale after reaching six of 24 storeys.
claims.episode_span: offered at $30 million in a court-ordered sale
claims.source_title: Unfinished 24-storey Surrey City Centre condo tower construction site listed for $30 million in court-ordered sale
claims.supporting_quote: A Surrey City Centre condominium tower project that reached just six storeys of its ultimate 24-storey height is being offered for $30 million through a court-ordered sale.

claims.claim: City of Vancouver staff recommend that council reject a 15-storey, 151-room hotel proposal at 852-872 Seymour Street, with the referral report set for November 17.
claims.episode_span: staff want the new council to reject a 15-storey hotel
claims.source_title: City of Vancouver staff urge rejection of 15-storey downtown hotel building proposal
claims.supporting_quote: At its Nov. 17 public meeting, City Council will consider the referral report for the proposal at 852-872 Seymour St.

claims.claim: EducationPlannerBC said that on November 3 it identified a cybersecurity incident affecting its application system.
claims.episode_span: on November 3 it identified a cybersecurity incident
claims.source_title: B.C. post-secondary application portal affected by data breach
claims.supporting_quote: In a Thursday update, EducationPlannerBC says that, on Nov. 3, it identified a "cybersecurity incident affecting its application system."

claims.claim: A coastal flooding statement is in effect for Vancouver, and Friday's temperature is forecast steady near 14 with showers beginning early afternoon.
claims.supporting_quote: Friday: Cloudy. Showers beginning early this afternoon. Wind east 30 km/h gusting to 50 except southeast 50 gusting to 70 near the water this afternoon. Temperature steady near 14.

claims.claim: Highway 1 from 256th Street in Langley to Lefeuvre Road in Abbotsford is closed until December 31.
claims.episode_span: closed around the clock until December 31
claims.source_title: DriveBC: 5 major road events in Metro Vancouver
claims.supporting_quote: Road construction from Highway 1, In Langley - District and 256th Street to In Abbotsford and Lefeuvre Road. Starting 12:00 AM PDT on Friday October 30, 2026 until 12:00 AM PCT on Thursday December 31, 2026.

claims.claim: Daily Hive counted 24 current Canucks players in a video of a visit to BC Children's Hospital and Ronald McDonald House.
claims.source_title: Vancouver Canucks had their best Children's Hospital showing in years
claims.supporting_quote: We spotted 24 current players in a video posted by the Canucks on Instagram.
